title: Ogre: movement system with terrain costs
description: Hex movement with movement points. Units spend MP to enter hexes — clear costs 1, crater costs 2, rubble costs 1. GEVs get two movement phases (move, attack, move again). Ogre movement: 3 MP base, reduced as treads are destroyed (tread_units/15 rounded up = current MP, minimum 0). Infantry move 2. Stacking: max 3 non-infantry per hex, infantry unlimited. No movement through enemy-occupied hexes.
close_reason: Movement points, terrain costs, stacking limits, Ogre multi-hex path movement, tread degradation. 11 tests.
